no_read_only_path.uds_19_0A_reportSupportedDTC: No CUORE function sends 19 0A. 19 02 with mask FF (step B1) already lists every DTC the module tracks with its status byte; 19 0A is not needed for the codes.
no_read_only_path.radio_ETM: Radio/nav (ETM 0x6F) is registered on CAN-IHS; with cable 'none' CUORE has no route to CAN-IHS.
no_read_only_path.parkview_camera_PAM: PAM (parking control) is registered on CAN-CH and its address is unknown; with cable 'none' CUORE has no route to CAN-CH. The only chance of seeing a camera/PAM node on CAN-C is the optional full address sweep (B8); a silent result is expected and is NOT evidence the module is absent.
no_read_only_path.DTCM_DASM_ESM_addresses: DTCM (0x29, unverified), DASM and ESM (address unknown) have no confirmed address for this VIN (addresses.json holds only ABS), so /module/{code}/dtcs|identity return 400. Only POST /api/live/discover (B7/B8) can find them; HTTP discover probes 22 F190 only (ops.discover(probe_dids=...) exists in Python but is not on HTTP).
no_read_only_path.mode09_beyond_VIN: Only Mode 09 PID 02 (VIN) has an ops/HTTP reader. Cal IDs/CVN/IUPR exist only inside fullscan (in-process mode09.read_mode09), which is on the forbidden list.
no_read_only_path.module_identity_store_kind: HTTP /identity records kind 'identity'; kind 'module_identity' is written only by ops.sweep_bus_full (fullscan), not reachable read-only over HTTP.
